title: Cardiovascular prediction: study tasks, cohorts and validation
question: How do these studies support heart-failure prognosis, biomarker interpretation and evaluation planning for cardiovascular AI?
scope: Compare three author-maintained evidence summaries for heart-failure prognosis and clinical AI research. This guide brings each paper’s reported task, population, endpoints, validation design and source-linked findings together for literature selection and Discussion writing.
reading_rule: Start with the contribution that matches your research question, then use the reported population, endpoint and validation design to choose the citation. The three roles here are external survival-model evaluation, admission-marker associations, and methodological planning for clinician–AI workflows.

studies.task: Admission TyG and subsequent HF outcomes
